name: @open-hax/knoxx
description: Knoxx - Knowledge mining and RAG platform

scripts.build: pnpm -C backend run build && pnpm -C frontend run build
scripts.test: pnpm -C backend run test && pnpm -C frontend run test:cljs && pnpm -C frontend run test
scripts.lint: pnpm -C backend run lint && pnpm -C frontend run lint && pnpm run lint:size
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C backend run typecheck && pnpm -C frontend run typecheck
